description: This Java class functions as a factory for obtaining an instance of FineractInitializer. It uses a singleton pattern to lazily initialize and provide access to the FineractInitializer bean within a Spring application context, dynamically loading configuration classes at runtime.

classes.name: FineractInitializerFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing access to a singleton instance of FineractInitializer using Spring's application context and dynamic configuration class loading.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FineractInitializer, initializing it if necessary.
